svg.title: Cross-cutting and general-purpose tooling in dr-serialize
svg.desc: A source-grounded map of the public helper API, internal foundational contracts, private mechanisms, their use by normalization, Canonical JSON Text, and identity, and a cautious assessment of possible future API candidates.
svg.text: Cross-cutting tooling: small public seams, guarded internals
Shared helpers span two separate lanes and the Canonical JSON Text utility surface.
Which helpers actually cross implementation surfaces?
Dots mean direct source use; labels name the consumer. A dash means the lane intentionally has a different mechanism.
Jsonable = None | bool | int | float | str | list[Jsonable] | dict[str, Jsonable]
The boundary vocabulary: normalization produces it; deterministic and identity code consume it.
JsonPath = tuple[str | int, ...] · SerializationError.diagnostics() → dict[str, Any]
One location grammar and persistable diagnostic shape span every failure taxonomy.
preview_repr(x: Any) → str · detail_repr(x: Any) → str
Bounded reprs standardize safe message previews (512 chars) and persisted detail (256 KiB).
One unexported byte-encoding invariant; callers cannot tune hash or measurement bytes.
Cycle-safe first-failure location for json.dumps-compatible diagnostics; not package-exported.
Shared bound for general hash truncation and display-only Identity Hash prefixes.
What helper-shaped tooling can consumers use today?
Every item below is re-exported from dr_serialize and listed in the README API surface.

g.text: They make lane composition and error locations type-visible.
Library retains path + depth bookkeeping; user handlers sit before fallbacks.
Frozen BaseModel boundary; the preset is storage policy, not universal truth.
Policy-free utilities; compose with normalization explicitly at the call site.
ValueTransformError is the supported base for consumer handler failures.
Construction · one-shot validation+hash · display-only prefix; none select identity fields.

svg.text: What might plausibly surface later—and what should stay hidden?
Promotion requires a stable consumer need and a contract worth freezing; internal reuse alone is insufficient.

g.text: PLAUSIBLE ONLY IF A CONSUMER NEED EMERGES
Useful for preflight validation or path-aware adapters.
first-failure order, cycle paths, key handling,
and non-finite policy. Its public-ish name does not yet make it package API.
Could support repeated external validation of full hashes.
do not export pre-emptively. A validator or nominal hash
type may be the better eventual contract than exposing an arithmetic constant.
Invariant ownership and implementation detail—not consumer capability.

svg.text: Decision rule: expose capabilities; hide mechanisms and invariants until an external contract is demonstrably needed.
Source: src/dr_serialize/__init__.py:30–102 · jsonable.py:18–89 · errors.py:14–181 · limits.py:28–57 · serialization.py:39–252 · canonical.py:23–67 · identity.py:44–388
